reached_sql:
select *
from (
    select
        g.i_category,
        g.i_class,
        g.i_brand,
        g.i_product_name,
        g.d_year,
        g.d_qoy,
        g.d_moy,
        g.s_store_id,
        g.sumsales,
        rank() over (partition by g.i_category order by g.sumsales desc) as rk
    from (
        select
            b.i_category,
            b.i_class,
            b.i_brand,
            b.i_product_name,
            b.d_year,
            b.d_qoy,
            b.d_moy,
            b.s_store_id,
            sum(b.sumsales) as sumsales
        from (
            select
                i.i_category as i_category,
                i.i_class as i_class,
                i.i_brand as i_brand,
                i.i_product_name as i_product_name,
                d.d_year as d_year,
                d.d_qoy as d_qoy,
                d.d_moy as d_moy,
                st.s_store_id as s_store_id,
                sum(coalesce(ss.ss_sales_price * ss.ss_quantity, 0)) as sumsales
            from store_sales ss
            inner join date_dim d on ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
            inner join store st on ss.ss_store_sk = st.s_store_sk
            inner join item i on ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
            where d.d_month_seq between 1217 and 1217 + 11
            group by
                i.i_category,
                i.i_class,
                i.i_brand,
                i.i_product_name,
                d.d_year,
                d.d_qoy,
                d.d_moy,
                st.s_store_id
        ) as b
        group by rollup(
            b.i_category,
            b.i_class,
            b.i_brand,
            b.i_product_name,
            b.d_year,
            b.d_qoy,
            b.d_moy,
            b.s_store_id
        )
    ) as g
) as dw2
where rk <= 100
order by
    i_category,
    i_class,
    i_brand,
    i_product_name,
    d_year,
    d_qoy,
    d_moy,
    s_store_id,
    sumsales,
    rk
limit 100
